title: 4-5 Years
excerpt: This period (which bridges the late preschool years and the start of formal schooling) sees rapid gains in language complexity, social understanding, motor coordination, and cognitive control, along with a generally-enhanced understanding of the causal forces
html: This period (which bridges the late preschool years and the start of formal schooling) sees rapid gains in language complexity, social understanding, motor coordination, and cognitive control, along with a generally-enhanced understanding of the causal forces underlying everyday experience (and the means to learn them).
